The process

How it works.

01

Connect Your Data

We plug in all your data sources and CRMs so everything flows into one place from day one.

02

Clean & Label Your Data

We sit with your team and sort through the messy stuff, making sure every data point is labelled correctly and actually readable.

03

Permissions & Access Control

Set up who sees what. You control which team members access which data and tools, nothing more, nothing less.

06

Milo Works for You

From here, Milo handles your day-to-day needs on its own. You get the results without the manual work.

05

Customise & Improve

We work with you to fine-tune the setup around your goals. No heavy training needed, just quick guidance on what you can get out of it.

04

Knowledge Base & Skills Setup

Every business runs differently. We map out your specific processes so Milo gives you results that fit how you actually work.
